name: launchos-layout-search
title: LaunchOS Layout Search
description: Search the apps, custom aliases, folders, and pages in your LaunchOS layout without changing it.
author: itsdanielsultan

commands.name: search-layout
commands.title: Search LaunchOS Layout
commands.subtitle: LaunchOS
commands.description: Find apps by their LaunchOS name or alias, filter by folder or page, and open the chosen app.

preferences.name: databasePath
preferences.title: LaunchOS Layout Database
preferences.description: Optional path to LaunchOS.sqlite. Leave blank to use LaunchOS’s standard local database.

preferences.name: includeHidden
preferences.title: Hidden Apps
preferences.label: Include apps hidden in LaunchOS
preferences.description: Show entries hidden in LaunchOS without changing their hidden state.
